purpose: Test whether accumulated corroboration can recover B09 without weakening V57's premature-alarm or healthy-control gates.

excluded_from_policy_selection.reason: fixed-fault diagnostics are not lifecycle early-warning devices

candidate_family.collapse_route: V57 hard raw evidence OR causal accumulated moderate-impulse and AE evidence, then V57 6-of-7 latch

held_out_healthy_snapshot_controls.acquisition_construction: two non-overlapping halves from each of 80 four-second MAT recordings, deterministic lexical condition and numeric repetition order
held_out_healthy_snapshot_controls.claim_boundary: healthy-snapshot operating-condition stress tests, not independent healthy machine-life experiments

safety_stop: If no candidate passes every selection gate, do not score K003-K006 and do not acquire or open B07. Report V62 as a negative development result.
